title: De l’Auscultation mediate; ou Traité du Diagnostic des Maladies des Poumons et du Cœur, fondé principalement sur le nouveau Moyen d’Exploration
version: Unsigned review in Medico-Chirurgical Journal, vol. II, no. 7, January 1820, pp. 461–494. NIH Back Issue Digitization scans served by Europe PMC.
lineage: The review summarizes Laennec’s 1819 treatise, and also supplies first-person reports of diagnostic trials and a separate report on imported instruments and their London reproduction.

passages.note: Reviews the 1819 Paris edition and describes the instrument.
Reviewers describe trying some of the cardiac diagnostics themselves and witnessing clinical examples.
The editor obtained cylinders from Paris, had Mr. Alnutt in Piccadilly make copies, and showed models at the editor’s residence. The price stated was four shillings.
